# Cached ICS must restore offline changes into the recreated cache before server playback, await additions while its observer batch is open, and let one reje

Cached ICS must restore offline changes into the recreated cache before server playback, await additions while its observer batch is open, and let one rejected item leave other items available. ICS/CalDAV cached callbacks must be taken and cleared per operation so a later playback cannot reuse an old callback and delete the wrong event. For overwrite, `modifyItem(item, null)` means overwrite current stored state; using `item` as its own base version can be rejected. [commit](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/e543c863fd4f), [D310564](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310564), [D310485](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310485).

Scope: calendar.

This is a workflow or historical planning observation.
